items.title: Phone stat strips cut figures mid-word at the edge with no fade, and values sit at different heights
items.cause: packages/ui/src/components/stat-grid.tsx:82-93: StatStrip is one element that is both the bordered card and the `overflow-x-auto` scroller, with no useScrollEdges and no scroll-fade-x (the tab strips and filter pills have both), and its dl is `flex w-max min-w-full`. packages/ui/src/components/stat.tsx:75 sizes compact cells `min-w-36 flex-1`: basis 0 plus an explicit min width replaces the content minimum, so a nowrap label crosses its divider and the screen edge lands on a divider, an icon or mid-word. `justify-center` on the same class makes values sit at different heights when only some cells carry a hint. One cause for nine reports.
items.fix: In StatStrip: (1) below sm, when the strip holds 4 figures or fewer (React.Children.count of the children), render the dl as `grid grid-cols-2` with hairlines (`[&>*:nth-child(even)]:border-l [&>*:nth-child(n+3)]:border-t border-line`, no divide-x), give the last cell `col-span-2` when the count is odd, and let labels wrap to two lines in this mode; nothing scrolls. (2) Otherwise (5+ figures on a phone, and every strip from sm up) move border, radius, surface and shadow to an outer `overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface shadow-1` div and make the inner role=group div the scroller: `scrollbar-none overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain scroll-fade-x snap-x snap-proximity`, plus `useScrollEdges(scrollerRef, { axis: "x" })`; keep the tabIndex-while-overflowing logic. In stat.tsx ROOT_CLASS.compact use `relative flex min-w-36 flex-[1_0_auto] snap-start flex-col justify-start py-3 pr-5 pl-4`. No call site changes: the home keeps variant 'strip' on phones and the 4-figure stocktake strip becomes 2x2 by itself (this supersedes the per-page fixes the reviewers proposed).

items.title: URL-state tabs and sections ignore client navigation (library settings ?section=, old library addresses)
routes: every useUrlState tab reached by a Link
items.cause: apps/web/lib/hooks/use-url-state.ts:13-16 reads `new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)` during render on the client. On an App Router navigation (a NavTabs Link, router.replace in master-data-page.tsx, or a page-level redirect() that the browser performs as a client replace) Next 15.5 renders the new tree first and commits the URL to history afterwards, so that render reads the old query and falls back to the default ('loanRules' in library-settings-view.tsx:46-50); nothing re-renders once the URL changes. Confirmed in code at 445fbb05. The reviewers agree on the cause; the extra next.config redirect change proposed in perpustakaan-2-02 is not needed once the hook is fixed.
items.fix: Read the value from `useSearchParams()` on the client too: `const requested = searchParams.get(key)`. Remove the `window.location.search` read, the popstate listener and the `refresh` state. Next 15 patches window.history.pushState/replaceState into useSearchParams, so write() (which already hands the history API `url.href`, a string, for the service worker wrapper) still updates the value. Keep write() as it is. No route or redirect change. Later, in the test phase: /library/master-data, /library/member-types, /library/loan-rules, every settings tab click and the back button must show their own section.

items.title: Sticky save bar and sticky form rows float 32px above the tab bar with page showing between

items.cause: packages/ui/src/components/sticky-save-bar.tsx:88 anchors the bar at `bottom-[var(--shell-mobile-tab-offset,0px)]`, and apps/web/app/globals.css:84-86 includes --shell-mobile-tab-raise (2rem, only the centre button's overhang) in that offset. The sticky FormActions rule (globals.css:174-179) uses the same offset.

StickySaveBar below md: `bottom-[calc(var(--shell-mobile-tab-bar,0px)+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]` and `pb-[calc(var(--space-3)+var(--shell-mobile-tab-raise,0px))]`, keeping `md:bottom-0 md:pb-3`. The tab bar comes later in the DOM at the same z-sticky, so the centre button paints over the save bar's bottom padding, never its buttons. Same change in globals.css:176-177: `bottom: calc(var(--shell-mobile-tab-bar) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); padding-bottom: calc(var(--space-3) + var(--shell-mobile-tab-raise));`. Keep --shell-mobile-tab-offset for the page's end padding. A bar without a centre action already sets the raise to 0.

items.title: Narrow pages centre their whole head, so title, trail and tabs jump about 216px between sibling pages
items.cause: packages/ui/src/components/page-shell.tsx:107-112 puts `mx-auto` and `max-w-narrow` on the whole page-column (breadcrumb, header, tabs, content). At 1440px a narrow page's head starts at x=480 while default-width siblings start at x=264. apps/web/features/settings/components/settings-page.tsx:35 defaults every settings page to narrow while branding, report-header, integrations, whatsapp and workflows pass default and audit-logs fit; self-check-in is narrow under the same nav as the default staff board; /library/me and /my-discipline are narrow beside default siblings. Reviewers proposed fixing SettingsPage only, or each view; the shared fix covers all 13 narrow call sites at once.
items.fix: In PageShell keep the default column (`max-w-default`, centred) for the narrow variant's page-column, so breadcrumb, header and tabs start at the same left edge as every other page, and apply `w-full max-w-narrow` to the page-content slot only (toolbar and body), left-aligned. Narrow keeps meaning '720px content'. In sticky-save-bar.tsx make the 'narrow' container line up with that content: a `mx-auto max-w-default` box whose inner row is `max-w-narrow`. Update the variant doc comment. No feature change is needed for the settings pages, /my-discipline or /library/me.

items.title: DataTable toolbar leaves orphan controls: a lone '...' row on phones, density and column icons over empty tables
items.cause: packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table-toolbar.tsx:241-302. The phone column menu (Ellipsis, `md:hidden`, order-2 ml-auto) is meant to sit beside the search box but renders even when showSearch is false, so it wraps alone onto its own row above the `order-4 basis-full` filters (audit logs: actor picker row, lone '...' row, pills row). The emptyOnPhone guard (line 214) only covers a table with no filters and no actions, and only below md. The density and column icons render from md up even when the table is empty and unfiltered (data-table.tsx:351, 400-415) or has a single hideable column. Reviewers proposed three variants (move pills beside the '...', hide the '...', add a viewOptions prop); this item combines them.
items.fix: (1) Render the phone column menu only when showSearch is true. (2) Add `viewOptions?: boolean` (default true) to DataTable and pass it to DataTableToolbar; render the density and column icons only when viewOptions is true, the table has rows or a search or filter is active, and, for the column menu, at least two columns can be hidden. (3) Generalise emptyOnPhone: when the toolbar holds nothing at a width, hide it at that width (`hidden` when empty at every width). Feature halves: FB-17 (audit-logs actor picker) and FA-15 (supervision passes viewOptions={false}).

items.title: Drag-to-dismiss can swallow the first upward scroll of a sheet
routes: every Dialog and Sheet on a phone
items.cause: packages/ui/src/components/overlay-drag.ts:203-213 calls preventDefault on any early touchmove with dy >= 0 on a body scrolled to the top, including dy = 0 and moves under the 8px slop; cancelling the first touchmove cancels native scrolling for the whole gesture.
items.fix: For touches that start in the body (`start.body` set), return without preventDefault while `dy < SHEET_DRAG.slop` or `dy <= Math.abs(dx)`, and only then claim the gesture (preventDefault, dragging = true). Keep the early preventDefault for touches on the handle and header.

items.title: Gradebook headers carry unexplained count badges; empty report score is an underlined dash

items.fix: Drop the CountBadge and append `· {missingShort}` to the caption line (142-144). Render a plain muted '–' when report_score is undefined.

items.cause: grading-view.tsx:201-226: grid-cols-2 with class and subject in row 1 and the term `col-span-2`.
items.fix: Put class and term in row 1 and give the subject select `col-span-2 sm:col-span-1`.

items.title: Timetable-setup warning icon shown to students and read-only viewers
items.cause: schedule-grid-cells.tsx:283, schedule-mobile-agenda.tsx:215-224 and schedule-mobile-day-list.tsx:~126-133 render BreakWarningBadge whenever crossesBreak, without checking canManage.
items.fix: Gate the badge on canManage at all three sites.

items.fix: Render the StatGrid only when the board has rows. Add today.emptyBodyReadOnly 'Belum ada pegawai dengan jadwal kerja.' (id and en, staffAttendance catalog) for readers without canSchedule.

items.cause: billing-view.tsx:58 uses the underline TabsList and its two longest labels push the fourth tab fully past 358px. The gutter bleed and wider fade are SH-14.

items.title: Observation detail: full-width prose, raw criterion key fallback, back link skips the teacher
items.cause: observation-detail-view.tsx:134 has no variant; Prose (:42) has no measure; :162 falls back to s.criterion_key; :138-142 build the trail without Hasil and the teacher.

items.title: Leadership and BK homes are lopsided: short main column, long side column
items.cause: leadership.tsx:219-250 puts school.atRisk and school.activity in `side`, counselor.tsx:186-200 counselor.atRisk; the side column already holds check-in, shortcuts and announcements.
items.fix: Move school.activity, school.atRisk and counselor.atRisk into `main`.

items.title: Check-in page repeats 'Jadwal belum diatur' and shows '– – –' rows
items.cause: self-check-in-view.tsx:134 (DayStatus) and :157-159 (unscheduledHint Alert) state the same fact; :205 adds a trailing DayStatus on every row; :197-203 always renders the hours range with placeholders; :74 takes 7 days under the title 'Minggu ini'; dashboard check-in.tsx:121 uses '-' where this view uses '–'.
items.fix: Hide the card's DayStatus and the row badge when status_code is 'unscheduled'; render row meta only when an arrival or departure exists, else 'Belum ada catatan'; rename thisWeek '7 hari terakhir'; for readers with manage_staff_attendance swap 'Hubungi admin' for a link to the schedule editor; use '–' in both views.

items.title: Queue sections inside home cards look like a second card title
items.cause: picket.tsx:172 and counselor.tsx (QueueSection) use SectionHeader as="h3" (text-heading) inside a Card whose title is also text-heading.
items.fix: Pass `size="sm"` (added by SH-30) to those SectionHeaders.

items.cause: leadership.tsx:299 sets href only for queues the reader can open, and ListRow draws a chevron only for links.
items.fix: `href={linkedQueues.includes(key) ? href : inboxHref}` (kepsek can open /inbox), so every row links and aligns.

items.title: Setup checklist cuts off the step counts on a phone
items.cause: onboarding/components/checklist-section.tsx:118-122 builds meta as `${description} ${count}`, and ListRow clamps meta to two lines.
items.fix: Show the count in ListRow `trailing` (`text-body-sm tabular-nums text-fg-muted`, keep the sr-only done text) and keep meta to the description.

items.title: Zona waktu shows raw IANA ids
items.cause: onboarding/components/school-profile-form.tsx:131 maps TIMEZONES (line 29) to options with `label: zone`.
items.fix: Label through onboarding catalog keys: timezones.wib 'WIB (Waktu Indonesia Barat)', wita, wit (en 'Western/Central/Eastern Indonesia Time'); keep the IANA value.

items.fix: grade_levels.description 'Daftar tingkat kelas (misalnya kelas 1 sampai 6) yang menjadi dasar pembagian kelas.' and count '{count} tingkat'.

items.title: Grade-level phone cards show bare 'X' and '1' lines
items.cause: grade-levels-view.tsx:106 shows the code as card subtitle and :112 the sequence as unlabeled card meta.
items.fix: Set the sequence column `card: "field"` (labelled 'Urutan 1') and show the code subtitle only when it differs from the name.

items.title: Desk and dashboard draw today's visits and shortcuts with different icons and tones
items.cause: desk-today-tiles.ts:2 and :47 use Users2 where library-dashboard-view.tsx:14, :87 use DoorOpen; desk-today-panel.tsx:122 uses `<IconCircle tone="neutral">` where the home's shortcuts are tinted.
items.fix: Use DoorOpen in desk-today-tiles.ts and the home's category tones for the desk shortcut icons.

items.title: Homeroom leave dates written in full and wrapping; bare bold empty lines
items.cause: homeroom-dashboard.tsx:111 joins two full formatDate calls; :175 uses `<EmptyState variant="compact" title={empty} />` with no icon (also in schedule-bulk-view.tsx).
items.fix: Use `format.dateTimeRange(start, end, { day: "numeric", month: "short" })`; give the compact empty states `icon={<CheckCircle2 />} tone="success"` as journal-today-panel.tsx:265-270 does.

items.title: Criterion numbering drawn three ways across supervision screens
items.cause: teacher-supervision-report-view.tsx:91 builds `${index + 1}. ${name}`; the detail and form use a muted leading number; observation-detail-view.tsx:162 shows none.
items.fix: Use the muted leading number (`w-5 text-right text-label text-fg-muted tabular-nums`) everywhere and drop the '1.' prefix.

items.title: ISBN lookup sits in a grey panel below its field with a disabled button
items.cause: isbn-lookup-panel.tsx:43-64 renders the hint and button in their own Card under the field (title-form.tsx:130-140).
items.fix: Put 'Cari ISBN' inline as the field's trailing secondary button; drop the hint and show the panel only for a result or 'not found'.

items.title: Class loan's only action is a faint disabled secondary button
items.cause: class-loan-borrow-panel.tsx:138-146 uses variant="secondary".
items.fix: Use the primary variant and add a caption 'Pilih kelas dan judul untuk meninjau' while disabled.

items.title: Import: template download sits after the upload it should precede; a stepper label wraps
items.cause: import-view.tsx:153-178 renders FileDropzone before the download Button; the 'Pemetaan kolom' step label wraps on phones.
items.fix: Move 'Unduh templat XLSX' above the dropzone (or into the CardHeader action) and shorten the step label to 'Pemetaan'.

items.title: Catalogue card shows a bare '-' line for a missing author
items.cause: catalogue-view.tsx:147 `row.original.author || "-"` with `card: "subtitle"`.
items.fix: Return null for a missing author on the card (keep '-' in the desktop cell, e.g. through a cell that checks the layout or a separate card-only column).

items.title: Loan rule switch label wraps in a narrow column inside the dialog
items.cause: loan-rules-view.tsx:279-281 uses Field orientation="horizontal" (14rem label column) inside a 480px dialog.
items.fix: Use `orientation="inline"`.

items.title: 'Orang hari ini' does not say how it differs from 'Kunjungan hari ini'
items.cause: library.id.json:850 visits.summary.totalPeople 'Orang hari ini'.
items.fix: Use 'Total pengunjung hari ini' and 'Anggota unik hari ini' for the second figure (en to match).

items.title: Bulk schedule page: template link indented; the preview is the one bare section
items.cause: schedule-bulk-view.tsx:186-193 uses variant="ghost" w-fit; :211-242 wrap the preview in a plain section.
items.fix: Use `variant="link"` (or -ml-3) and wrap the preview in Card with CardHeader.

items.title: Login chart writes '13:00' where the app writes '13.00'
items.cause: login-activity-chart.tsx:44, :51, :59 build `${pad(peakHour)}:00` by hand.
items.fix: Format through the locale: `format.dateTime(new Date(Date.UTC(2000, 0, 1, peakHour)), { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "UTC" })`.

items.title: Check-in clock reads '1 4.1 4' from tabular figures
items.cause: self-check-in-view.tsx:130 sets tabular-nums on text-kiosk-display.
items.fix: Drop tabular-nums from the clock.

items.title: 'Tinjau' is a verb dressed as an amber status badge
items.cause: homeroom.tsx:223-226 `trailing={<Badge tone="warning" size="sm">{t("card.review")}</Badge>}`.
items.fix: Drop the badge (the row links and has a chevron) or use the status noun 'Menunggu tinjauan' in dashboardTeaching.id.json.

items.title: Notification rows unreadable on a phone: the full date squeezes the title to 'Pen…'
items.cause: apps/web/features/notifications/components/notifications-view.tsx:262 passes formatRelative(...) as ListRow `trailing`; past 24h it returns the full date and time (packages/i18n/src/format.ts:68-69). The trailing slot is `display: contents` with whitespace-nowrap (packages/ui/src/components/list-row.tsx:197-202), so the text never shrinks and the title column collapses. Confirmed in code. A regression from before the overhaul.
items.fix: Rows already sit under a day heading, so the trailing slot only needs the time: formatTime(item.created_at, { locale, timeZone }) for items not from today and formatRelative only for today's. Below sm, optionally move the time into `meta` on its own caption line, as the bell panel does (notification-panel.tsx:113-115).

items.title: Kesiswaan pages set their own h1 and eyebrow, so the title repeats the tab and changes per tab
items.cause: AppPage derives h1 = area label and eyebrow = sidebar group (components/app-page.tsx:122, 132-135), but these views override them: violations-view.tsx:54-55, warning-letters-view.tsx, counseling-view.tsx:117-118 (eyebrow 'Konseling BK'), at-risk-students-view.tsx:174 (title only, so its eyebrow says 'Kesiswaan' beside a 'Konseling BK' sibling), leave-requests-view.tsx:39-40, late-arrivals-view.tsx, achievements-view.tsx, clubs-view.tsx, activities-calendar-view.tsx, mentor-groups-view.tsx, and duty-view.tsx:98 (eyebrow 'Piket' repeats its title). Areas elsewhere keep the area as h1.
items.fix: On area pages with tabs pass no `title` and no `eyebrow`, so the h1 is the area label and the eyebrow the sidebar group (the activities workspace label comes from SH-27). In duty-view drop the eyebrow override (falls back to the 'Piket dan gerbang' group). Keep documentTitle per tab where the views set it.

items.title: Activities and discipline lists show the header's create button again as a second primary
items.cause: Each view passes a primary Button as the EmptyState action while AppPage primaryAction renders the same button: achievements-view.tsx:149-159 and 190-200, activities-calendar-view.tsx:147-163, counseling-view.tsx:176-190, violations-ledger-view.tsx:267-281. On gurubk's Pelanggaran the raised centre tab 'Catat' makes a third entry.
items.fix: Give these EmptyState actions `variant="secondary"` (or drop them) wherever the header already carries the action; keep a primary only where the reader has no header action.

items.title: Action inbox buries the one request under count tiles and a duplicate chip filter; its buttons sit under the tab bar
items.cause: apps/web/features/permits/components/permit-unified-queue.tsx: StatTiles at 229-248 (2+1 on phones via tileColumns, line 150), a bare Input at 250-260, and a flex-wrap row of primary/secondary Buttons as type chips at 273-292 that wraps to two rows. The tiles and chips name the same three categories; the first request starts near 700px. Used only by inbox/components/action-inbox-view.tsx.
items.fix: Drop the StatTile grid. Render the kind filter as `<SegmentedControl size="sm" fullWidth="phone" options={[{ value: "all", ... }, ...sources.map((s) => ({ value: s.type, label: s.label, count: s.query.data?.data.length }))]} />` (one row, edge fades, carries the counts). Replace the Input with SearchInput (size sm, onClear). Put search and filter in one `flex w-full flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row` row and shorten or drop the queueHint paragraph.

items.title: Staff leave page is a dead end that loops through the inbox
items.cause: apps/web/features/permits/components/leave-requests-view.tsx:85-99: IssuerQueueUnavailable is the whole page and its only action goes to /notifications. apps/web/features/inbox/components/action-inbox-view.tsx:20-23 and :59 offer 'historyLeave' (/leave-requests) to anyone who can open it, though only a submitter has a history there, and HISTORY_LINKS has nothing for the librarian's late-arrival queue.
items.fix: In action-inbox-view offer historyLeave only when useCanSubmitPermit() is true, and add `{ href: "/late-arrivals", label: "historyLate" }` ('Lihat riwayat keterlambatan' in inbox.id.json and en). In IssuerQueueUnavailable point the primary at `/inbox?type=leave` (label app.permits.leave.issuerOpenInbox), keep notifications as a secondary TextLink, and title the page app.permits.leave.issuerTitle (both keys added by SH-12).

items.title: Mentoring groups: two primary 'Buat kelompok' buttons and a search toolbar over an empty list
items.cause: apps/web/features/mentoring/components/mentor-groups-view.tsx:146-157 sets the header primaryAction and 206-217 give the EmptyState an identical primary Button when canManage; the DataTable at 173-193 keeps its search toolbar while empty.
items.fix: Leave the EmptyState action undefined when canManage (the header carries it; on the 'mine' scope consider no create action at all). Pass `searchable={items.length > 0 || search !== ""}`. The view icons over the empty table go away with SH-05.

items.title: SP meter legend sits one tick to the left of its markers and repeats them
items.cause: apps/web/features/discipline/components/points-meter.tsx:53-60 gives each Progress marker a label ('SP 1', 'SP 2', 'SP 3') and :61-77 lays a separate legend out as `grid auto-cols-fr grid-flow-col`, equal thirds starting at 0%, so 'SP 2 · 50' sits under the SP 1 tick. student-discipline-panel.tsx:111-119 puts the 'poin lagi menuju' sentence before the figure it explains.
items.fix: Drop `label` from the markers (keep the ticks) and position each legend item at its threshold (absolute, `left: min_points/scaleMax*100%`, `-translate-x-full text-right`). Put the '0 poin' figure above the sentence.

items.title: Raw ISO dates ('2026-11-17') under club members and in the achievements table
items.cause: apps/web/features/activities/components/club-detail-view.tsx:175 builds meta from raw m.joined_on and m.left_on (formatDate is imported but unused there); achievements-view.tsx:110 renders achieved_on with no cell formatter.
items.fix: Format with `formatDate(value, { locale, timeZone: "UTC" })` behind activities catalog keys such as clubs.joinedOn 'Bergabung {date}' and clubs.leftOn 'sampai {date}'; give the achieved_on column the same formatter.

items.title: Club and achievement rows end in two mismatched text buttons; the name gives no cue it opens the club
items.cause: apps/web/features/activities/components/clubs-view.tsx:120-150 renders a secondary 'Ubah' and a ghost 'Hapus' in the actions column, which the phone card pulls into its corner (data-table-cards.tsx:209); the name is a Link styled only on hover (:80-87) and no onRowActivate is set. achievements-view.tsx:111-139 repeats the pattern. clubs-view.tsx:115 shows the normal 'Aktif' as an accent badge (the clubs half of cross-18).
items.fix: Use RowActionsMenu with 'Ubah' and a destructive 'Hapus' (as expected-guests-view.tsx does); set onRowActivate to `router.push(`/activities/clubs/${id}`)` and render the name as plain text. Render the normal 'Aktif' state as quiet muted text.

items.title: Notifications toolbar shrink-wrapped: placeholder cut, controls stop short, four control rows on a phone
items.cause: notifications-view.tsx:119 wraps the toolbar in `<div className="flex flex-col gap-3">`, a content-sized flex item inside PageShell's flex-wrap toolbar row (page-shell.tsx:146), so `sm:flex-1` on the SearchInput (line 142) has nothing to grow into. Confirmed in code. (The same wrapper on the Buku tamu board is FA-16.)
items.fix: Use `className="flex w-full flex-col gap-3"`; give the SegmentedControl `fullWidth="phone"`; move 'Tandai semua dibaca' from `actions` to `secondaryActions` so it joins the header menu on a phone.

items.title: Fourth duty mode 'Catat manual' is invisible on a phone
items.cause: apps/web/features/permits/components/duty-view.tsx:52 and 115-121 pass four MODES to SegmentedControl; each segment is as wide as the widest label (segmented-control.tsx:150-151), about 115px x 4 in a 358px track, and the scroll edge falls exactly after 'Izin keluar', so the fade has nothing to fade. Confirmed in code.
items.fix: Take 'manual' out of MODES (it is a task, not a scan mode) and make it the AppPage primaryAction 'Catat manual' (existing purposes.manual label, ClipboardPen icon) opening DutyManualRecordPanel in a Dialog (a bottom sheet on phones); keep a `mode=manual` URL as an alias that opens the dialog. The three remaining segments fit. This avoids a root-catalog copy change.

items.title: Pelanggaran on a phone is all chrome: settings editors sit beside the data views as tabs
items.cause: apps/web/features/discipline/components/violations-view.tsx:66-71 lists 'Katalog pelanggaran' and 'Kebijakan SP' (settings editors) as sibling pill tabs of the two data views, so the track is wider than 358px and cut mid-word; with the header button, area tabs, search and filters the list starts at 51% of the screen.
items.fix: Move the catalog and SP policy editors into AppPage `secondaryActions` (buttons on desktop, the header overflow menu on a phone) that open ViolationCatalogView and DisciplinePolicyView in a Sheet (side right on desktop, bottom on a phone). The TabsList keeps 'Catatan poin' and 'Kandidat SP', which fit one line.

items.title: Early-warning level tiles shrink to 80px squares at the left of an empty row
items.cause: apps/web/features/analytics/components/risk-level-summary.tsx:42 renders `<StatGrid variant="tiles" className="grid-cols-3">` as the AppPage toolbar (at-risk-students-view.tsx:213), a flex-wrap row where the dl shrinks to its content; StatGrid's default `sm:grid-cols-4` (stat-grid.tsx:105) also stays. Confirmed in code. The chevron half is SH-16.
items.fix: Set `className="w-full grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-3"` on the StatGrid, or render RiskLevelSummary in the page body instead of the toolbar.

items.title: Club detail is built unlike its siblings: inline join form, bare search, one-tap removal
items.cause: club-detail-view.tsx:105-140 (inline join form with a pale disabled 'Daftarkan' that wraps on phones), :142-159 (raw Input and Checkbox), :181-205 (leave.mutate straight from the button), and MeetingsPanel :232-259 (the same inline pattern). The header gives no club facts.
items.fix: Make 'Daftarkan anggota' the AppPage primaryAction opening a Dialog with StudentPicker and DatePicker (Field required). Replace the Input with SearchInput and the checkbox with a boolean filter pill, or list members through DataTable mode="local". Show schedule, quota and location in the description or a small DataList Card. Put 'Keluarkan' in a RowActionsMenu destructive item behind ConfirmDialog. Treat 'Jadwalkan pertemuan' the same way.

items.title: Mentoring group members: mixed button styles, a plain-text destructive action, and a split toolbar
items.cause: apps/web/features/mentoring/components/mentor-group-members-panel.tsx:78-109 renders a secondary 'Lihat siswa' and a ghost 'Keluarkan' in the actions column (the phone card slot is sized for one icon); :123-141 builds its own row with the count and a size-sm 'Tambah anggota' above a DataTable with searchable={false}, whose toolbar then holds only the view icons.
items.fix: Give the DataTable onRowActivate to `/mentoring/groups/{groupId}/students/{id}` and replace the actions cell with a RowActionsMenu ('Lihat profil siswa', and 'Keluarkan' with tone danger behind the existing confirm, only when canManage); render the name as plain text. Pass the add Button (default size) through DataTable toolbarActions, move '1 dari 15 anggota' into a SectionHeader description or the footer, and show the at-capacity note as the disabled button's hint.

items.title: Student profile header: ragged stacked buttons on a phone, mixed sizes on desktop
items.cause: apps/web/features/students/components/student-profile-view.tsx:152 passes StudentDisciplineReportButton (secondary size sm, discipline/components/student-discipline-view.tsx:55-69) as the free `actions` node, which PageHeader keeps as a visible wrapping row on a phone (page-header.tsx:248-257), while 'Ubah data' is already in the overflow menu. The report hook useOpenReport is private to student-discipline-view.tsx:29, which is why students and discipline sit in the same stream.
items.fix: Export the hook from student-discipline-view.tsx (e.g. `useOpenStudentDisciplineReport`) and in the profile view pass the report as a secondaryActions entry ({ label: t("printReport"), icon: <Printer />, onSelect: () => report.open(studentId) }) instead of `actions`. On a phone it joins the overflow menu; from 640px it renders at the same size as 'Ubah data'.

items.title: Audit log phone toolbar takes three rows; the actor filter looks like a form field among pills
items.cause: apps/web/features/audit/components/audit-logs-view.tsx:250-275 passes a DirectoryPicker as DataTable actions, which takes its own full-width phone row (data-table-toolbar.tsx:255) and on desktop sits as a bordered field at the far right while the other filters are pills. The lone '...' row is SH-05.
items.fix: Render the DirectoryPicker with `size="sm"` and `className="w-full sm:w-56 sm:rounded-full"` so it reads as a filter pill on desktop; after SH-05 the phone toolbar is picker row plus pill row.

items.title: WhatsApp activation switch floats mid-card with its hint stranded beneath it
items.cause: apps/web/features/messaging/components/provider-config-view.tsx:180-187 uses `<Field orientation="horizontal">` (a 14rem label column plus control column, field.tsx:220-221) in an otherwise vertical form, unlike session and SSO.
items.fix: Use the shared SettingSwitchRow (features/settings/components/setting-switch-row.tsx) as session-settings-view.tsx:131 and sso-view.tsx:165 do: label activeLabel, hint activeHint, checked form.isActive.

items.title: Activities forms: truncated day select, no required markers, unexplained disabled Simpan, two date pickers
items.cause: club-form.tsx:130 (grid sm:grid-cols-3 for day, start, end); required on controls, not Field (club-form.tsx:90-96, achievements-view.tsx:305-341, activities-calendar-view.tsx:273-306); achievements-view.tsx:356 disabled={!studentId}; activities-calendar-view.tsx:303-306 two DatePickers.
items.fix: Put 'Hari pertemuan' on its own row and the two times in grid-cols-2; move required onto Field; keep Simpan enabled and show the Field error on submit; use DateRangePicker for event dates.

items.title: Redesigned discipline and early-warning detail pages are not reachable from their own lists
items.cause: at-risk-students-view.tsx:238-240, violations-ledger-view.tsx:259-261 and issued-letters-panel.tsx:171-173 push studentProfileHref(...) (the general profile), never /discipline/students/[id] or /analytics/[id], although those pages' breadcrumbs claim the lists as parents.
items.fix: Route the rows to `/discipline/students/${id}` (ledger, issued letters) and `/analytics/${id}` (at-risk list), so the list and the breadcrumb agree.

items.title: Template editor and integrations copy: code syntax and developer jargon in user text
items.cause: documents.id.json editor bodyLabel 'Isi (HTML)', bodyHint with '{{nama_placeholder}}', knownPlaceholdersEmpty ('Placeholder ...'), detailsTitle 'Templat', unknownPlaceholdersHint relying on colour ('Yang berwarna kuning'); integrations.id.json:5 and :19 ('endpoint', 'akses mesin'); template-editor.tsx:88 shows 'Ubah templat' while loading. (The root substitution_responded string is SH-12.)
items.fix: documents: bodyLabel 'Isi templat'; bodyHint 'Pakai tombol Sisipkan data otomatis di bawah untuk bagian yang diisi saat dokumen diterbitkan.'; knownPlaceholdersEmpty 'Jenis dokumen ini belum punya data otomatis dari sistem. Tulisan dalam kurung kurawal akan tampil apa adanya.'; detailsTitle 'Detail templat'; unknown hint in words ('Data yang ditandai Tidak dikenal akan tampil apa adanya') with a Badge label. integrations:5 'Hubungkan aplikasi lain ke data sekolah: kunci API untuk mengambil data, dan webhook untuk mengirim kabar saat ada kejadian baru.'; :19 '...memberi aplikasi lain akses ke data sekolah ini.'. While loading, show a Skeleton title instead of 'Ubah templat'. en in step.

items.title: Settings leftovers after the shared narrow-page fix: WhatsApp form width and a two-line SSO description
items.cause: whatsapp-settings-view.tsx:32 caps its form at md:max-w-2xl, a third width; messages/features/sso.id.json description (117 characters) wraps to two lines and moves the tab strip 20px. The header jump itself is fixed by SH-04.
items.fix: Use `max-w-narrow` in whatsapp-settings-view.tsx. Shorten the SSO description to one line, e.g. 'Izinkan staf dan guru masuk dengan akun Google Workspace sekolah.' (en to match).

items.title: Mentoring search placeholder cut mid-word on a phone
items.cause: mentoring.id.json:39 placeholder is too long for the phone field, and mentor-groups-view.tsx:185 uses it on both scopes.
items.fix: Shorten to 'Cari kelompok atau guru wali'; for scope 'mine' use a new myGroups.searchPlaceholder 'Cari kelompok'.

items.title: Template preview is a blank white sheet until the body is typed
items.cause: template-editor.tsx:316-323 always renders the sandboxed iframe with aspect-[1/1.2], even when previewHtml is empty.
items.fix: When body.trim() is empty, render a compact EmptyState (document icon, new key editor.previewEmpty 'Pratinjau muncul setelah isi templat diisi') in the sunken frame; below lg wrap the preview in a Disclosure collapsed until there is content.

items.title: Report hub page sits 16px lower than other pages; inactive section triggers point at missing panels
items.cause: reports-workspace-view.tsx:95 wraps the section page in a single `<TabsContent value={selected.key}>` (TabsContent adds pt-4, tabs.tsx:159), and only that panel is mounted, so other triggers' aria-controls point nowhere; reports-view.tsx:73 adds gap-5 on top of its TabsContent pt-4.
items.fix: Make the section strip a NavTabs of `?section=` links (it navigates), or render one TabsContent per section with the view only in the selected one and `className="pt-0"`. In reports-view.tsx use gap-4 on the inner Tabs and pt-0 on its TabsContents.

items.title: Unread notifications are announced as the current item
items.cause: notifications-view.tsx:249 passes `selected={unread}`, so ListRow sets aria-current and the selected tint (list-row.tsx:75, 82, 94, 138).
items.fix: Drop `selected={unread}`; unread already has the bold title and tinted icon circle. If a tint is wanted, pass it through className (e.g. `bg-accent-soft/40`) without aria-current.

items.title: Report centre says 'Excel' while the dialog also offers PDF
items.cause: messages/features/reports.id.json `description` 'Unduh laporan sebagai berkas Excel.' while components/report-export-dialog.tsx:324-325 offers Excel and PDF. (The library wording half is FA-31.)
items.fix: Reword to 'Unduh laporan sebagai berkas Excel atau PDF. Hanya laporan yang boleh dijalankan akun ini yang ditampilkan.' (en to match).

items.title: Profile avatar changes colour from the header's; long name truncated on a phone
items.cause: avatar-upload.tsx:80 renders `<Avatar size={64}>` without tone, so it hashes the name, while the header passes tone="accent" (components/account-menu.tsx:95-110); profile-identity.tsx:26 truncates the name.
items.fix: Add `tone="accent"` to that Avatar; replace `truncate` with `line-clamp-2 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]` in profile-identity.tsx.

items.title: Early-warning signals card mixes three value styles; the header lacks NIS
items.cause: student-risk-panel.tsx:77-111 (a whole sentence in text-title-lg at :92-94, a bare number at :97); student-risk-detail-view.tsx:38-40 passes only the profile link as description.
items.fix: Give each signal one shape: a text-title-lg number plus a caption unit (analytics catalog keys 'poin aktif', 'surat', 'hari tidak hadir'), the attendance bar under its number. Reuse the NIS plus profile-link description from student-discipline-view.tsx:113-118.

items.title: 'Riwayat konseling' card uses a smaller inset than the cards above it
items.cause: student-counseling-history.tsx:99 uses Card padding="sm" while student-discipline-panel.tsx:80 and :144 use md and the default.
items.fix: Use Card padding="md".

items.title: Early-warning phone cards are loose and the chevron floats above the name
items.cause: at-risk-students-view.tsx:116-156: the title cell renders its own Avatar plus StudentLink (lifted to 44px on cards) and score is a card field.
items.fix: Render the name as plain text on the card (the card opens the row), move the class into the title cell's second line (class column card: "hidden"), and make score card "meta" ('Skor 0') beside the level badge.

items.title: Duty: 'Perlu tindakan' link reads as a status; desk log empty state is a bare sentence
items.cause: duty-view.tsx:224-228 uses a muted TextLink with app.duty.queue.openInbox; :325-328 render the empty desk log as a plain p.
items.fix: Use the accent TextLink with a ChevronRight (label becomes 'Lihat semua' via SH-12); render the desk-log empty as EmptyState variant="compact" with a domain icon.

items.title: Club schedule written '15:00-16:30'
items.cause: clubs-view.tsx:97-101 joins raw meeting_start and meeting_end with '-'.
items.fix: Use clockRange from features/schedule/clock-label.ts (import only; that folder belongs to features-a and is not edited here): 'Jumat, 15.00–16.30'.

items.title: Empty 'Surat terbit' offers no way forward
items.cause: issued-letters-panel.tsx:175-180 renders EmptyState with no action.
items.fix: For readers with view_discipline add secondaryAction `<TextLink href="/discipline/violations?tab=atRisk">Lihat kandidat SP</TextLink>` (discipline catalog key).

items.title: Late-arrival reason field ('Isi sebelum memindai') sits after the live camera
items.cause: late-arrivals-view.tsx:111-134 passes the reason Field as Scanner children, rendered after the viewfinder and manual entry (scanner.tsx:311-318); the camera submits on its first read.
items.fix: Render the reason Field before the Scanner in the same max-w-xl column, so the hint matches the order on screen.

items.title: Mentor's student snapshot: bare attendance counts, a squeezed stat grid, four mostly empty full-width cards
items.cause: student-snapshot-sections.tsx:74-88 renders a status badge and a raw count ('Belum lengkap 30'); :112 `grid-cols-2 sm:max-w-md` keeps StatGrid's sm:grid-cols-4, so 'Pelanggaran aktif' wraps; :153 a dense List in an unpadded Card; mentor-student-view.tsx:68-77 stacks the sections in one column.
items.fix: Render the count through a new mentoring key studentView.attendance.days '{count} hari'; use `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:max-w-md`; use List (not dense) in the grades card; wrap the three sections in `grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3 lg:items-start` with the term summary full width below.

items.title: Term summary textarea has no label; small Simpan
items.cause: mentor-term-summary-panel.tsx:82-90 renders the Textarea outside a Field; :93-96 Button size="sm".
items.fix: Wrap it in `<Field label={t("summaryLabel")}>` (new key 'Rangkuman'), default Button size, max-w-prose on desktop.

items.title: Exit permits: two rows of tab-like navigation before the scanner
items.cause: exit-permits-view.tsx:100-113 puts the Gerbang/Setujui SegmentedControl in the AppPage toolbar under the area tabs.
items.fix: Pass the SegmentedControl (size sm) through Scanner `headerEnd` (added by SH-10) and render the same control in ApprovePanel's header (exit-permit-panels.tsx), so the page has one navigation row.

items.title: Leave request detail (code review): generic h1, raw student name, decision buried at the end
items.cause: leave-request-page-view.tsx:14-19 (narrow, title detailTitle, one Card); leave-request-detail.tsx:88-94 (heading as a p), :100 (raw student_name), :169-238 (actions and the issued Alert at the bottom).
items.fix: Lift the query into the page view: title = the category label, description = `${formatDisplayName(student_name)} (${class_name}) · ${range}`; skip the in-card heading on the page; use formatDisplayName at :100; move the issued Alert above the stepper; put the review buttons in a CardFooter, sticky on phones via AppPage floating; use the default variant.

items.title: Template row: name truncated on a phone; no open cue on desktop
items.cause: document-templates-view.tsx:117-150 passes a ghost 'Jadikan bawaan' Button as ListRow action, which hides the chevron (list-row.tsx:129) and takes 40% of a phone row; the title truncates (list-row.tsx:163).
items.fix: Use a RowActionsMenu ('Ubah', 'Jadikan bawaan') in the action slot and pass titleLines={2}.

items.title: Personal notification preferences list the same 12 kinds for every role
items.cause: apps/web/features/notifications/api.ts:33-62 (NOTIFICATION_KIND_MODULE, useNotificationKinds) filter kinds by enabled modules only, never by whether the reader can be a recipient.
items.fix: Add NOTIFICATION_KIND_AUDIENCE mapping each kind to the permissions that make a reader its recipient (undefined = everyone) and a useOwnNotificationKinds() that filters by me.permissions; use it in settings/components/notification-settings-view.tsx only (notification-defaults keeps the full list).

items.title: Theme tiles squeeze their hints into a 110px column
items.cause: appearance-view.tsx:50 'grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3' inside the 720px card.
items.fix: Stack the tiles at every width (`grid gap-3`) or use lg:grid-cols-3 with icon above label; shorten 'Ikuti sistem' hint to 'Ikut tema perangkat.'.

items.title: Settings hub on a phone is 16 separate cards, not a settings list
items.cause: settings-hub-view.tsx:90-109 renders each entry as Card interactive in 'grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2' at every width (4556px at 2x for admin).
items.fix: Below sm render each section as one `<List framed>` of ListRows (IconCircle in the section tone, title, description as meta, chevron); keep the card grid from sm up.

items.title: Hub section description promises cards the reader cannot see
items.cause: settings-hub-view.tsx:88 always prints the static section description while settings-hub.ts:125-135 drops cards the reader cannot open.
items.fix: Return `complete` from buildSettingsHubSections and pass the description only when the section is complete (or build it from the visible card labels).

items.title: WhatsApp provider keeps its own always-on Simpan instead of the settings save bar; no error state
items.cause: provider-config-view.tsx:189-193 renders FormActions with its own Button and no dirty state; :77-79 handle only isLoading.
items.fix: Lift the form state into a hook (useProviderConfigForm) used by WhatsAppSettingsView, pass `floating={<SettingsSaveBar dirty saving onSave onDiscard />}` to its SettingsPage while the Penyedia panel is active, remove FormActions, and add `if (query.isError && !query.data) return <QueryError retry={() => query.refetch()} error={query.error} />` as session and SSO do.

items.title: SSO status card repeats the page title and holds a single callout
items.cause: sso-view.tsx:163-176 always renders a FormSection titled statusTitle ('Masuk dengan Google', the page name); unconfigured, its only child is the Alert.
items.fix: When !data.configured render the Alert as the first child of the credentials FormSection (:178); pass the status badge to SettingsPage `actions`; keep the switch card only once configured and retitle statusTitle 'Di halaman masuk' (id and en).

items.title: Passkey empty state is larger than the 2FA control above it
items.cause: passkeys-section.tsx:192-197 renders EmptyState with no variant, which becomes 'inline' (px-6 py-8) inside the Card.
items.fix: `<EmptyState variant="compact" className="px-5 pb-5" icon={<Fingerprint />} title={t("emptyTitle")} action={addButton("secondary")} />` without the description.

items.title: 2FA button glued to a status sentence that repeats the badge
items.cause: security-view.tsx:121 wraps the body in a raw `flex flex-col gap-3 px-5` div with no bottom padding before a CardFooter that adds only pt-1 (card.tsx:195); status.disabledBody repeats the badge.
items.fix: Use `<CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">`; render the status paragraph only when confirmed, or replace disabledBody with 'Disarankan untuk akun dengan akses data sekolah.' (id and en).

items.title: Session page: two cards for two controls, the first titled like its only field
items.cause: session-settings-view.tsx:118-138 renders two FormSection cards; sessionTitle equals daysLabel ('Lama sesi').
items.fix: Put the NumberInput field and the SettingSwitchRow in one FormSection variant="card" titled app.settings.session.rulesTitle 'Aturan sesi' (key added by SH-12).

items.title: WhatsApp on a phone: two tab rows, then a card header naming the tab again; panel not in the URL
items.cause: whatsapp-settings-view.tsx:26 `<Tabs defaultValue="provider" className="... gap-5">` with TabsContent's default pt-4 (tabs.tsx:159); provider-config-view.tsx:102-105 repeats the panel name as CardTitle.
items.fix: Keep the panel in the URL with useUrlState("panel", ["provider", "templates", "deliveries"], "provider") as workflow-definitions-view.tsx:63 does; gap-6 on Tabs and pt-0 on each TabsContent; drop the provider CardTitle and keep its sentence as CardDescription.

items.title: Workflow summary orders method before approver, the reverse of the rows; repeats them on a phone
items.cause: stage-editor.tsx:214-224 maps Stepper description to the verification method and actor to the approver rule; the muting is SH-38.
items.fix: Pass description: ruleLabel(item.stage.approver_rule) and actor: the verification label; show the summary card from lg up only (`hidden lg:block` on the Card at :205).

items.title: Exit permit detail writes times as '13:45'
items.cause: permits/components/exit-permit-detail.tsx:60 slices the raw API time. (The schedule half is FA-33.)
items.fix: Use clockLabel or clockRange from features/schedule/clock-label.ts (import only).

items.title: Sign-in: stacked full-width buttons of two heights; the passkey button pops in after load
items.cause: login-form.tsx:144 sets the submit to size lg while passkey-login-button.tsx:53-61 uses the default size; the block appears after hydration (the snapshot half is SH-26).
items.fix: Pass `size="lg"` to the passkey Button (and the Google button if it takes a size); keep the passkey button disabled until the page has hydrated, like the Masuk button.

items.title: Report icons repeat; a leave request has three different icons across the app
items.cause: reports-view.tsx:35-40 keys icons on the kind's first segment; permit-unified-queue.tsx:79 uses Inbox for leave; notifications-view.tsx:59 ClipboardList.
items.fix: Key report icons on the full kind ('permits.leave_requests' to domainIcons.leave, 'discipline.warning_letters' to domainIcons.warningLetter) and use domainIcons.leave in the queue and the notifications KIND_ICON map (icons added by SH-29).

items.title: Live preview sits two screens below the fields on a phone
items.cause: report-header-view.tsx:196 and branding-view.tsx:145 use a grid that becomes two columns only at lg.
items.fix: Below lg add a secondary 'Lihat pratinjau' button near the top that opens the preview in a bottom Sheet and hide the trailing card with max-lg:hidden.

items.title: Notification matrix rows use a 16px inset inside a 20px card
items.cause: notification-channel-matrix.tsx:120 uses px-4 for the phone rows and default 16px table cells. (The FormSection inset is SH-37.)
items.fix: Use px-5 and give the table's first and last cells pl-5 / pr-5.

items.title: Student overview: two dash styles for 'no value' and 'Lihat semua' on an empty history
items.cause: student-overview.tsx:122 and :160 hard-code '-' while DataList uses '–' (data-list.tsx:96); the 'Lihat semua' link renders regardless of history length.
items.fix: Use '–' in the stat tiles and hide 'Lihat semua' when the history is empty.

items.title: Scan intro takes four lines above the viewfinder on a phone
items.cause: messages/features/scan.id.json `intro` is several sentences. (The viewfinder layout is SH-10.)
items.fix: Trim the intro to one sentence (id and en).

items.title: Report catalogue on a phone is six tall cards each with its own 'Unduh'
items.cause: reports-view.tsx:112-170 renders the same Card grid at every width (about 1300px on a phone).
items.fix: Below md render a List of ListRows (IconCircle, title, description as meta, chevron), each opening the args form in a bottom Sheet; keep the grid from md up; rename the card button 'Atur unduhan' (reports catalog).

items.title: Empty counseling list tells the reader to 'Klik baris' when there are no rows
items.cause: discipline.id.json:240 (same wording in mentoring.id.json:95).
items.fix: Keep only 'Catatan konseling Anda akan muncul di sini.' in both catalogs (en to match).

items.cause: brand-asset-upload.tsx:110-112 sizes the preview box itself (size-16 logo, size-12 favicon).
items.fix: Wrap the preview in a fixed slot `<div className="flex w-16 shrink-0 justify-center">`; on phones keep only 'Maksimal 2 MB' in the hint.

items.title: Four look-alike icon controls end each workflow stage row
items.cause: stage-row.tsx:135-155 renders move up/down IconButtons and the RowActionsMenu at 89-111 lists the same moves.
items.fix: Keep reordering in one place: remove the inline arrows and leave the moves in the menu.

items.title: WhatsApp secret fields differ from SSO's: status as placeholder, no reveal toggle
items.cause: provider-config-view.tsx:130-143 and 163-176 use Input type="password" with status sentences as placeholders (messaging.id.json accessTokenPlaceholderSet/Unset).
items.fix: Follow sso-view.tsx:195-207: PasswordInput, placeholder 'Tidak diubah' when a token is saved, and the explanation as Field hint; same for the gateway header value.

items.title: SSO Client ID placeholder cut mid-word on a phone
items.cause: sso.id.json clientIdPlaceholder is 37 characters, wider than the 294px field.
items.fix: Drop the placeholder and add clientIdHint 'Berakhiran .apps.googleusercontent.com' passed as Field hint (sso-view.tsx:184).
